name: Crazy Cattle Vita
description: Port of the Unity remake of Welcome to Crazy Cattle 3D.
long_description: Port of the Unity remake made by Dimolade. Welcome to Crazy Cattle 3D, an exhilarating battle royale game where you control explosive sheep in a chaotic survival challenge across three distinct global environments. Master physics-based movement, outwit your opponents, and be the last sheep standing!
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
